projects.title: Aplier
projects.description:
Co-developed a full stack job matching app that makes career hunting easier. Technologies used include Javascript, React, Apollo, GraphQl, AWS Cognito.
Aplier used graphQL as the query language for our backend and Apollo for the connection to the front-end.

projects.title: Blip
projects.description:
Blip is a travel app that allows you to geotag and create a collection of your favorite vacation spots.
Once you have a collection it is easy to share those collections with your friends and family.
Technologies used in this React-Native app include, Apple’s Map API, and React native hooks.
Developed Wireframe, user navigation through Expo and the apps UI, UX.
